component.name: OpenBangla Keyboard
component.summary: Type Bengali using phonetic and fixed keyboard layouts

description.p: OpenBangla Keyboard is a Unicode-compatible Bengali input method for Linux. It supports Avro Phonetic and fixed layouts including Probhat, Munir Optima, Avro Easy, Bornona and National (Jatiya).
Typing aids include dictionary suggestions, autocorrection, a layout viewer and a phonetic preview window. Users can edit autocorrect entries and use Avro Keyboard layout files.
